title: The answer is in the subagent's result and the agent only points at it
expected: The recap says what was found: the export job's S3 credentials expired.

steps.user: Find out why the nightly export job fails.

subagent.prompt: Read the last five runs of the nightly export job and find the root cause of the failures.
says: Every failing run stops at PutObject with AccessDenied.
subagent.result: Root cause: the export job's S3 credentials expired on 1 November; every run since gets AccessDenied on PutObject.

check.why: nothing the user asked for is left unaddressed
the finding is recorded as what the agent did
